Name: Golden Eggs
Author: HJellybean327
Description:
[b]Depreciated for 1.6+
[/b]
Makes golden eggs and chickens obtainable before perfection, but still late in the game to keep it balanced.

Golden eggs become purchasable from Marnie for 100,000g (same price as after perfection) after you gain access to the Walnut Room on Ginger Island.

Price can be changed by editing the "StockPrice" line in the shops.json file.

Tested on Windows.
